rationale: The June frozen set's expected fragments referenced pre-merge personal-vault IDs that have since drifted through the +1000 IDEA-034 merge and ongoing renumbering. Neither +1000 nor identity recovers them, so this is a content-based re-curation against the live 2026-07-04 vault, not a mechanical remap. 5 June questions were dropped as orphaned (no current entry): U3 (Gmail label-color), D2 (OV embedder crash-on-startup), D5 (jump-pod worktrees), X4 (Gmail-project tasks), C3 (compendium audit-log pattern).

scoring.match: case-insensitive substring: match_fragment in top1 result id/uri. OV filename-based URIs and pgvector entry_ids both contain the entry id, so match_fragment == lowercased entry id is stack-agnostic.
scoring.negative: match_fragment == 'NONE' => expect zero results above threshold (TN); any result => FP.
scoring.special: R2 uses fragment 'bug-' to match ANY homelab bug (report-style enumeration).
scoring.ground_truth_check: vault_path must resolve against the live vault (validate_groundtruth.py).
